title: Fixed Slotted Incline and Suspended Weight Apparatus
description: One newly authored complete static inclined-plane teaching apparatus appearance. A broad low ground board carries one narrow lower-pivoted inclined board, a genuine open curved side slot with a fixed headed pin, one complete block resting on the sloping top and a high grooved sheave held by two cheeks and a full axle. One continuous finite cord rises from the block, wraps around the upper wheel groove and descends to one whole fixed hanging weight. All geometry newly authored; no drafting desk board, architectural ramp, drying-rack cord or old pulley mesh extracted. Unlike a tall drawing desk with rear wedge bearings, and unlike ceiling-hung timber drying rods on independent hoist cords. One whole fixed prop, zero scenes. Blank surfaces and no angle scale, equation or numeric measurement. No motion, equilibrium, friction, tension, mechanical advantage, working adjustment, load, structural capacity, manufacture, operating steps, classroom suitability or safety claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made and outside static delivery scope.
